title: The Khalsa Moves Against an Exposed Sirhind

blocks.text: The Sirhind episode opens with timely intelligence rather than immediate combat. News spreads that Sirhind was exposed because its officer was away on revenue collection, and that temporary weakness invites a rapid Khalsa move before the city can be properly secured again.

The Singhs respond through consultation and collective resolve, treating the moment as one that must be seized rather than merely observed. Their decision turns scattered information into operational momentum.
On the other side, warning reaches Zain Khan and forces him into anxious movement. The episode begins, therefore, with a race between Sikh initiative and Mughal recovery.
